create.name: Drew Cali
create.bio:
Drew Cali is an evidential psychic-medium, Reiki Master and spiritual teacher based in the New York and northern New Jersey area. He describes coming to the work after significant losses in his own life, when a meditation practice opened him to spirit guides and mediumship. He then spent years in courses and mentorships, including study at the Arthur Findlay College for Mediumship and Psychic Sciences in England, and he is a certified medium listed with Helping Parents Heal. He is also an Army infantry veteran.

His work centres on connecting people with loved ones in spirit, alongside psychic guidance, Reiki and guided meditation, and he sums up his approach as practical: if it does not help or apply to real life, it probably is not real. He gives private and family readings by Zoom, phone and in person in Saddle River, New Jersey, runs small group readings and live spirit-message evenings, and teaches workshops on mediumship, intuition and past life regression. His YouTube channel shares guided meditations and recorded reading sessions.

courses.title: Private Spirit Reading
courses.description: A one-to-one evidential mediumship session by Zoom, phone or in person in Saddle River, New Jersey, focused on connecting with loved ones who have passed. Life readings and family readings for three to five people are also offered on the same sessions page.

courses.title: Past Life Regression | Live Zoom
courses.description: A live online workshop in which Drew Cali guides participants through a past life regression. Held on Zoom in the evening, Eastern Time.

courses.title: Small Group Reading - December 6 via Zoom
courses.description: A mediumship session on Zoom limited to five people, with readings for each participant. One of a regular series of small group dates.

courses.title: SPIRIT MESSAGES (Saddle River NJ)
courses.description: An in-person evening of spirit messages in Saddle River, New Jersey, where Drew Cali delivers readings to members of the audience. Seats are booked in advance.

courses.title: SPIRIT MESSAGES (Saratoga Springs NY)
courses.description: A live gallery evening of mediumship at The Inn at Saratoga in Saratoga Springs, New York. Drew Cali passes on messages from spirit to people in the room.
